pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/triggers.rs:3 The trigger pipeline is server-side job chaining: a completed job enqueues a downstream job, limited by cycle and depth guards. There is no coding-agent session, turn boundary, continuation record or compaction anywhere in it. I searched triggers.rs, the 7 e2e files and all of crates/server/src for compaction, PreCompact, transcript, turn boundary and continuation mode and found 0 hits, so the subject's precondition does not hold. This looping belongs to background-jobs and pipeline-dag.
